titleText: Three critically injured in head-on collision in Luqa
mainText: From Times of Malta: Three critically injured in head-on collision in Luqa. Five ambulances and more than 20 emergency workers dispatched to crash scene

titleText: Libya suspects drone strike on Russian ship caused blast in Benghazi
mainText: From Times of Malta: Libya suspects drone strike on Russian ship caused blast in Benghazi. There was no immediate claim of responsibility for the strike, but it comes as Ukrainian forces have stepped up their long-range barrages against Russia far beyond the front lines.

titleText: EU will 'not endorse' climate deal, throwing COP31 deal into doubt
mainText: From Times of Malta: EU will 'not endorse' climate deal, throwing COP31 deal into doubt. Panama also formally objected to the proposed deal as the summit plunged into a tumultuous finale

titleText: 575 contraventions, 55 charges issued to motorists at road checks in October
mainText: From Times of Malta: 575 contraventions, 55 charges issued to motorists at road checks in October. Police conducted 380 road checks in one month
